czechia.summary: Severoatlantická aliance se připravuje na rozsáhlý konflikt na východě a Evropská unie se mění ve vojenskou alianci proti Rusku, uvedl Sergej Naryškin, šéf ruské zahraniční rozvědky SVR. czechia.title: Česko by se podle Macinky mohlo podílet na americké zbrojní výrobě

latvia.summary: Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis uzskata, ka Krievijas sāktais karš pret Ukrainu varētu ilgt vēl divus līdz trīs gadus, un devis rīkojumu valstij gatavoties turpmākai agresijas atvairīšanai. Par to, atsaucoties uz anonīmiem avotiem Ukrainas valdībā, ziņo britu izdevums The Economist. latvia.summary: Augšdaugavas novadā aizturēts Latvijas pilsonis, kurš, bēgot no robežsargiem, mēģināja pārvadāt piecas nelegāli robežu šķērsojušas personas. Robežsargi Tabores pagastā mēģināja pārbaudei apturēt kādu “Nissan” markas automašīnu, taču tās vadītājs nepakļāvās robežsargu likumīgai prasībai un turpināja braukt. Robežsargi nekavējoties uzsāka automašīnas vajāšanu, kuras laikā […]

latvia.title: “Mēnesnīca” atklāj jauno sezonu: pavisam drīz jau gaidāms pirmais koncerts
latvia.summary: Ogres novada, Turkalnē, jau ceturto gadu pēc kārtas savu sezonu uzsāk kultūrtelpa “Mēnesnīca”, piedāvājot unikālu koncertpieredzi dabas ieskautā, intīmā un meditatīvā vidē. “Mēnesnīca” ir kļuvusi par īpašu satikšanās vietu mūzikas un iekšējās izaugsmes cienītājiem – koncertvakari norisinās saulrieta laikā, ļaujot saplūst mūzikai, dabai un klusumam. latvia.summary: Ir cilvēki, kas gatavi apsolīt zvaigznes no debesīm, bet tālāk par tukšiem solījumiem netiek. Citi maz runā, bet dara, neko neaizmirst un ir ļoti mērķtiecīgi. latvia.summary: “Par tā sauktajiem kropļu bataljonu gājieniem ir parādījies daudz informācijas,” tā TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” sacīja Jānis Slaidiņš, NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks. latvia.summary: Krievija paziņojusi par nodomu vērsties Starptautiskajā Tiesā saistībā ar it kā notiekošu “krievu apspiešanu” Latvijā, Lietuvā un Igaunijā. latvia.summary: Rīgas valstspilsētas pašvaldības Ārtelpas un mobilitātes departaments (ĀMD) 2026. gada 26. februārī izsludināja iepirkumu Rīgas ielu apgaismojuma ESKO dokumentācijas izstrādei. latvia.summary: Izraēla šodien apstiprināja, ka dienu iepriekš veiktajā gaisa triecienā Gazas pilsētā likvidēts palestīniešu grupējuma “Hamās” bruņotā spārna jaunais vadītājs Mohammeds Odehs. latvia.title: Rhododendrons bloom magnificently at Latvian botanical gardens
latvia.summary: The vibrant rhododendron blooming season has begun at the University of Latvia (LU) Botanical Garden at both of its locations in Rīga and Babīte, according to garden representatives. Together, the two sites form the largest rhododendron collection in the Baltics.

latvia.title: Vai Rosļikovs kā personība var būt izdevīgs Krievijai? Politologs vērš uzmanību uz vienu svarīgu niansi
latvia.summary: “Vai Aleksejs Rosļikovs kā personība var būt izdevīgs Krievijai, ja viņi izdomātu šeit nodibināt kaut kādu DNR jeb Doņeckas republikas modeli?” Šādu jautājumu TV24 raidījumā “Ziņu TOP” uzdeva Filipam Rajevskim, politologam. Viņš norāda, ka šāds scenārijs neesot viennozīmīgi interpretējams, bet viņa atbilde ir: “Nē, noteikti nē – viņš jau nav latvietis,” viņš politologs, vienlaikus pievēršoties […]

latvia.title: Tourists are afraid to visit Latvia's eastern Latgale region
latvia.summary: Evidence is growing that recent events near Latvia's eastern border – repeated drone incidents, regular airspace threat warnings, mobile phone alerts, NATO fighter jets being scrambled – are having serious consequences for the tourism industry, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Joint wind orchestra to come together in Balvi, Latvia
latvia.summary: When dozens of trumpets, tubas, and saxophones play together, wind music becomes not only something to be heard, but also something to be felt. On Saturday, May 30, wind orchestras from Vidzeme and Latgale will come together in the eastern town of Balvi for the concert "Skanēt savā laikā" (Sound of Our Time).

latvia.title: Riga Airport reports improved profit
latvia.summary: RIX Riga Airport maintained stable operational performance in 2025 and closed the financial year with a profit of EUR 4.2 million, EUR 0.8 million higher than the previous year, according to the company’s audited annual report for 2025, released on May 26th.

latvia.title: Latvia still has a lot of work regarding LGBTIA+ rights
latvia.summary: An annual European ranking table published by ILGA-Europe, an LGBTIA+ (lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, asexual, and other non-conforming identities) rights advocacy group, as usual, places Latvia slightly above Lithuania but way below Estonia when it comes to rights for LGBTIA+ people.

latvia.title: Latvia in search of new chancellery head
latvia.summary: Not only must Latvia select a new Prime Minister, but also the highest-ranking public official – the Director of the State Chancellery. The two previous holders of the position were forced to step down. Jānis Citskovskis is already on trial, while criminal proceedings have been initiated against Raivis Kronbergs. Now a successor must be chosen for this important position, Latvian Television reported on May 26.

latvia.title: Tourists like Latvia in July, not so much in February
latvia.summary: The importance of the summer season to Latvia's tourist trade is underlined in fresh Eurostat figures.

latvia.title: Latvia will face Norway next at ice hockey world championship
latvia.summary: Having secured a place in the IIHF ice hockey world championship quarter finals, it is now clear that Latvia's opponents will be Norway.

latvia.title: Illegal migrants caught in Ogre forest, far from Latvian border
latvia.summary: For the first time in Birzgale Parish, Ogre Municipality – in central Latvia, not in a border region – eight people who had entered Latvia illegally were detained this week, Latvian Television reported on May 27.

latvia.title: Regular train service restored on Rīga-Tukums line
latvia.summary: It has become easier and faster for passengers on the Tukums and Skulte railway lines to reach their destinations, as six-month-long repairs on these lines, which significantly impacted electric train service, have been completed, Latvian Radio reported on May 27.

latvia.title: Wind, hail, thunder to tear through Latvia Wednesday
latvia.summary: On Wednesday, northwesterly winds across Latvia will intensify to 15–20 metres per second in gusts; the strongest gusts may uproot trees in some areas, forecasters warn.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 26th May, 2026
latvia.summary: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: PM candidate Kulbergs names Latvia's new government
latvia.summary: Prime Minister candidate Andris Kulbergs (United List) has officially announced the composition of the incoming government on Tuesday, May 26. This has also been confirmed by President Edgars Rinkēvičs.

latvia.title: Eight is great! Latvia through to knockout stages of ice hockey world championship
latvia.summary: Latvia's young ice hockey team turned on the style against Hungary on Tuesday to definitively seal a spot in the knockout stages of the IIHF ice hockey world championships in Switzerland.

latvia.title: Latvia has EU's second highest at-risk-of-poverty rate
latvia.summary: Fresh Eurostat data show Latvia having the second highest at-risk-of-poverty (AROP) rate in the European Union (EU) in 2025.

latvia.title: Over 1,300 students had exams postponed due to air threats in Latvia
latvia.summary: Approximately 1,350 pupils will take the second part of the Latvian language exam during the extended testing period, as their exams last week were disrupted by a potential airspace threat, according to information available to the State Education Development Agency (VIAA).

latvia.title: Latvians work longer hours than Estonians, shorter hours than Lithuanians
latvia.summary: In 2025, the actual weekly working hours of EU full-time and part-time workers aged 20-64 in their main job averaged 35.9 hours, down from 36.9 hours in 2015, according to the latest Eurostat statistics.

latvia.title: Latvia in global top 50 for startups
latvia.summary: The latest StartupBlink Global Startup Ecosystem Index 2026 report has been published and places Latvia in 48th place worldwide, reports Labs of Latvia.

latvia.title: It's Latvia versus Norway at ice hockey world championship
latvia.summary: The approval of a new government is only the second most-important thing of the day in Latvia on Thursday, with the national ice hockey team taking on Norway in the IIHF world championships in Switzerland this evening.

latvia.title: Latvia's new coalition pledges to work together
latvia.summary: Representatives of the political parties forming the new coalition – the United List (AS), the National Alliance (NA), New Unity (JV), and the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) – signed a coalition agreement and a declaration on the government’s planned activities on Thursday morning, LSM.lv reports.

latvia.title: Progressives: ZZS staying in Agriculture Ministry unacceptable
latvia.summary: The Union of Greens and Farmers continuing to lead the Ministry of Agriculture is unacceptable, stated Andris Šuvajevs, the leader of the opposition faction Progressives, on Thursday, May 28, on the Latvian Television programme Morning Panorama.

latvia.title: More anti-mobility barriers deployed on Latvian border
latvia.summary: This month, the National Armed Forces (NBS) began deploying the first anti-mobility barriers, so-called dragon's teeth, on the expropriated territories along the Latvian-Russian border, LSM's Latgale editorial reports on May 28.

latvia.title: Thursday will be just as windy in Latvia
latvia.summary: On Thursday, northwesterly winds will pick up again in Latvia, with gusts only slightly weaker than those experienced on Wednesday, forecasters warn.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 27th May, 2026
latvia.summary: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

lithuania.title: Lenkijos pasieniečiai pasienyje su Lietuva sulaikė 14 neteisėtų migrantų
lithuania.summary: Lenkijos pasieniečiai pranešė apie dar vieną neteisėtos migracijos atvejį pasienyje su Lietuva. Per vieną dieną Podlaskės vaivadijoje sulaikyta 14 užsieniečių, neteisėtai kirtusių Lietuvos ir Lenkijos sieną, skelbia miastosuwalki.pl.
